reader.requirement: In a Format 1 (TALLYING-only) INSPECT, identifier-1 is a sending data item: the statement never stores into it, its length (including an OCCURS DEPENDING ON group) is taken as a sender's, and so an alphanumeric function-identifier is admitted there while a Format 2/3/4 (REPLACING/CONVERTING) with a function-identifier identifier-1 is refused as a receiving operand (§1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR3a).

edition-consulted.switches: construct numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002: a numeric/integer function as identifier-1 is refused at 85 (COBOL0900), admitted from 2002
DialectBehavior.InspectFormat3LengthIdentifiedOnce: Format 3 ODO length re-read for the REPLACING half at 85 (not on the Format 1 path)
DialectBehavior.InspectBeforeFromFirstEligiblePosition: BEFORE measured from leftmost at 85 (matching rule, not the sending/receiving partition)

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|Version|Year in InspectBinder.cs; the sending/receiving partition itself (`modifies` = REPLACING or CONVERTING present; ResolveSending vs ResolveReceiving; FunctionIdentifierReceiving COBOL1632) consults no edition and is the same arm at 85 and 2023.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: for THIS rule the Format 1 sending treatment is edition-invariant; only the operand-class admission of numeric functions (an SR4 matter) differs.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f13_03 covers unchanged identifier-1 and alphanumeric function-identifiers; not exercised: ODO group identifier-1 length, reference-modified identifier-1, numeric-edited identifier-1, and the refusal of a function-identifier in Formats 2/3/4.

probes.expected: ODO group G at N=3 is inspected over 3 characters (GR1); ref-mod (2:3) of banana has two a's; numeric edited ' 10.50' inspected as alphanumeric (GR3b) with one space; FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(W2) BEFORE INITIAL 'A' counts 0 N's and W2 unchanged

probes.expected: refused: a function-identifier may not be a receiving operand (§1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR3a); identifier-1 is sending only in Format 1
